name: ipcmanagement
description: Hệ thống quản lý bếp ăn công nghiệp (IPC Management System)

scripts.gen:api:spec: dotnet tool restore && dotnet build backend/src/IPCManagement.Api/IPCManagement.Api.csproj -c Release -p:UseAppHost=false -o .artifacts/contract-build/api && dotnet swagger tofile --output frontend/src/shared/api/contracts/openapi.json .artifacts/contract-build/api/IPCManagement.Api.dll v1
scripts.test:be:coverage: dotnet test backend/IPCManagement.slnx --settings backend/coverage.runsettings --collect:"XPlat Code Coverage" --results-directory backend/TestResults
scripts.coverage:be: npm run clean:coverage:be && npm run test:be:coverage && npm run coverage:be:report
scripts.test:ui-completeness: npm run test:unit -w frontend -- --run tests/operationalStateActionRegistry.test.ts tests/uiCanonSourceInventory.test.ts tests/uiStatePurityContract.test.ts --maxWorkers=1 && node --input-type=module -e "import fs from 'node:fs'; const fail=(message)=>{throw new Error(message)}; const expected=[...Array.from({length:18},(_,index)=>'PB-'+String(index+1).padStart(2,'0')),'PF-01','PF-02']; const read=(file)=>fs.readFileSync(file,'utf8'); const rows=(text)=>text.split('\n').filter((line)=>line.startsWith('| PB-')||line.startsWith('| PF-')).map((line)=>line.split('|').slice(1,-1).map((cell)=>cell.trim())); const scalar=(text,key)=>Number(text.split('\n').find((line)=>line.startsWith(key+':'))?.split(':')[1].trim()); const matrix=read('docs/UI-CONFORMANCE-MATRIX.md'); const ledger=read('docs/UI-CONFORMANCE-FAILURE-SELECTION.md'); const matrixRows=rows(matrix); const ledgerRows=rows(ledger); if(JSON.stringify(matrixRows.map((row)=>row[0]))!==JSON.stringify(expected)) fail('P5 matrix IDs drifted'); if(JSON.stringify(ledgerRows.map((row)=>row[0]))!==JSON.stringify(expected)) fail('P6 ledger IDs drifted'); if(matrixRows.some((row)=>row.length!==6||row.slice(1).some((cell)=>!cell))) fail('P5 matrix row is incomplete'); if(ledgerRows.some((row)=>row.length!==4||row.slice(1).some((cell)=>!cell))) fail('P6 ledger row is incomplete'); const selected=scalar(ledger,'selected_failures'); const red=scalar(ledger,'red_assertions_created'); const selectedRows=ledgerRows.filter((row)=>row[2]==='SELECTED').length; const conditional=fs.existsSync('frontend/tests/uiConformanceSelectedFailures.test.ts'); if(selected!==selectedRows||red!==selected||conditional!==(selected>0)) fail('P6 selected/red/conditional contract drifted'); console.log('P5/P6 ledger contracts: 20/20 IDs, selection '+selected+', RED '+red);"
scripts.verify: npm run test:architecture-growth && npm run check:architecture-growth && npm run build:be && npm run test:be && npm run test:ui-completeness && npm run test:fe:unit && npm run lint:fe && npm run depcruise:fe && npm run build:fe
scripts.verify:coverage: npm run coverage:be && npm run coverage:fe
